# GreyStudio

> GreyStudio is a Hyderabad, Telangana-based local marketing and creative studio helping brands build regional visibility through on-ground activations, creative production and creator partnerships.

## Website
- Homepage: https://www.greystudio.online/
- Booking: https://www.greystudio.online/book

## Local marketing and creative services
- Local brand activation and retail marketing: WPC foam boards, standees, retail displays, dealer promotions and on-ground campaign execution.
- Advertising and creative production: advertisement shoots, product photography, promotional videos, reels and campaign assets.
- Influencer and creator collaborations: local creators, Telugu influencers, regional YouTubers, creator discovery and campaign coordination.
- Print and retail collateral: pamphlets, flyers, brochures, catalogues and branded promotional materials.
- Branding and design: brand identity, graphic design, social media creatives and campaign communication.
- Websites and apps: responsive, search-friendly websites and business app experiences.

## Location and coverage
- Based in Hyderabad, Telangana, India.
- Supports local and regional campaigns.
